description:
Diversify the current tech-heavy portfolio by adding a defensive stock position. 

1. Add 'Coca-Cola' (Symbol: KO) to 'My Watchlist'.
2. Record a BUY transaction for KO in 'My Portfolio':
   - Date: March 10, 2024
   - Units: 200
   - Price: $60.00
3. Navigate to the Portfolio Summary view to see the asset allocation.
4. Configure the view to show the 'Stock' distribution Pie Chart.
5. Take a screenshot of the pie chart showing the new allocation and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/allocation_chart.png'.
